hooks.command: command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/no_commit_on_main.py"; f=0; while IFS= read -r l; do case $l in *commit*) f=1;; esac; done; [ $f -eq 0 ] || { echo "no-commit-on-main: python3 not found, cannot check the branch" >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
